description:
Freelance partnership delivering small to mid-size WordPress websites, along with SEO optimization and Google Ads management.
  • Developed a WordPress website leveraging Elementor Pro and custom PHP functionality.
  • Created a secure platform for managing and selling school class photos and children’s profile images to parents.
  • Managed all administrative duties, including operations, coordination, and support.
  • Launched and managed Google Ads campaigns for multiple clients.

Automated content production platform focused on data-driven content creation across multiple marketing channels.
  • Served as lead developer for several automated content-production tools built with Vue.js enabling generation of adaptable layouts for a wide range of marketing channels.
  • Led development of a dashboard platform, overseeing the full application lifecycle from ticket creation and feature scoping to UX/UI design and front-end implementation.
  • Built and maintained automated CI pipelines with GitHub Actions, ensuring consistent testing and reliable releases.
  • Responsible for qualifying candidates, onboarding, and technical mentoring of new developers.
  • Supported an external client in the blockchain space by building and refining React interfaces while temporarily embedded in their team.
  • Implemented comprehensive component and end-to-end testing across all repositories using Cypress.
  • Led the refactoring of automated content-production tool, resulting in 60% less CloudFlare cost.

Web agency delivering a wide range of digital products for clients, including websites, apps, chatbots, ad banners, and more.
  • Worked on wide range of client websites, focusing on creating clean, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces.
  • Worked closely with designers and backend developers to ensure smooth integration of UI/UX and functionality.
  • Followed best practices, wrote maintainable code, optimized performance, and prioritized delivering great user experiences.
  • Led the development of a large website for a major Danish client.
  • Led the development of two WordPress websites from concept to launch.

A digital service company specializes in developing digital solutions for businesses and institutions, offering comprehensive services in consulting, design, and programming.
  • Delivered specific components for the Tækniskólinn website following atomic design principles.
  • Focused on systematically improving the UI through user testing and iteration.
